\begin{example} \end{example}[The wave equation via Fourier transform] ↗ thm:fourier-transform-properties ↗ ex:exponential-plane-wave-solutions 1. ch4:4.3.1-ex-4\group Fourier Transform

For $u_{tt}-\Delta u=0$, $u(\cdot ,0)=g$, $u_t(\cdot ,0)=0$, \[ \hat u(y,t)=\frac{\hat g(y)}2(e^{it|y|}+e^{-it|y|}), \] and hence \[ u(x,t)=\frac1{(2\pi )^{n/2}}\int _{\R ^n}\frac{\hat g(y)}2 \left(e^{i(x\cdot y+t|y|)}+e^{i(x\cdot y-t|y|)}\right)dy. \] \end{example}
